verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes a local HTTP API and plugin system that could be used to script bulk edits across many blocks/pages, and its query language ({{query}}) can surface many items at once, but there is no documented native bulk-operation feature (e.g., mass rename, bulk tag, batch move) demonstrated in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-update API or UI feature, evidence of an AI agent actually performing bulk operations via the HTTP API, independent hands-on confirmation of scale.
